newsitem.title: UK: J.P. Morgan to re-focus base metal operations.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan to re-focus base metal operations.

text.p: U.S. investment house J.P. Morgan and Co Inc is to re-focus its base metal trading activities away from day-to-day trading and towards long-term structured deals.
In future, Morgan will not be making markets to other brokers, but will instead continue to offer hedging and financial products where it can provide added value, a J.P. Morgan spokesperson said.
"We are re-focussing our strategy...and putting more focus on strategic hedging products," the spokesperson said.
Morgan is an Associate Broker Clearing London Metal Exchange (LME) member.
J.P. Morgan was not a particularly large player in short-term trading. There have not been any staff reductions, the spokesperson added.

Trade sources said that the J.P Morgan move was a logical step, in that the banking and investment house sector of the market is more suited to offering long-term finance deals to the industry, as well as warrant baskets, leaving broking to the specialised dealer companies.
